summary: A small web service where members borrow and return books from a shared catalog.
constraints: Members are identified by their email address.
A loan lasts 14 days and can be extended once.

features.title: Browse the catalog
features.goal: Anyone can see which books exist and whether they are available.
criteria: Anyone can list all books with title, author and availability.
Searching by title returns only matching books.
out_of_scope: Reserving a book that is out.

features.title: Borrow a book
features.goal: A member can borrow an available book.
criteria: A member can borrow an available book.
Borrowing a book that is already out is refused.
The due date is 14 days after the borrow date.

features.title: Return a book
features.goal: A member can return a borrowed book so it becomes available again.
criteria: Returning a loaned book makes it available again.
Returning a book twice is refused.
features.notes: Late fees are decided later and are not part of this version.
